text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Pardon us for intruding, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for sharing a table~♡ Satono, 
Kitasan, Cheval-chi!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's really crowded at this hour, after 
all! Come on in, take a seat!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
You're all in gym clothes already? Were 
you doing voluntary training before lunch?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the three of us together. Being 
together seems to fill us with more 
motivation than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of motivation, during that 
fishing trip the other day—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We got so fired up that we headed out 
super early in the morning!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Kita-chan and I couldn't catch 
anything at all and started dozing off 
halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan was totally different, though! 
All right, Cheval-chan, announce how many 
you caught!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Th-Thirty-three, but... That day was 
just a fluke...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah~♡ Cheval-chi, that's amazing~♡ Going 
fishing together sounds like so much fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I just had a great idea! Let's all 
have a fishing party next time~!!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
A fishing party... Fufu, how novel and 
delightful! Perhaps serving everyone the 
fish you caught yourself?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Exact~ly! Let's do it together~~♡ Hey, if 
it's fishing, Cheval-chi will have fun 
too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
...Training is important too, after all. 
Cheval, you are free to do as you like.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Right now... I want to train... 
so...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I see. In that case, another time then♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'll be going now...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we'll excuse ourselves as well. We're 
scheduled for a parallel run together.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Eating with you was lovely. 
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Just one request... Could you please pass 
this to Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Onee-chan? You've looked sooo happy for a 
while now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, because Cheval is... playing with 
friends, working hard to improve 
together...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That is... yeah. I'm glad she seems well.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's what matters most. I must let 
Papa and Mama know too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what was that bag you gave to 
Satono?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Ah, that is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the spectator stands at twilight, I 
spotted several horse girls deep in 
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
This is... the salad we used to eat at 
home. Even the dressing recipe is here...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wah, so many different veggies! What a 
super nutritious salad!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She must be looking out for your health, 
Cheval-san... Fufu, what a wonderful, 
caring older sister.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...She really is amazing, my sister.
